title: TrackSpace DSA 110
summary: A curated 110-problem DSA curriculum organized across 13 core problem-solving patterns, from arrays and trees to graphs, dynamic programming, and advanced data structures.
description: TrackSpace DSA 110 is a pattern-based Data Structures and Algorithms curriculum covering 110 LeetCode problems across 13 core patterns: Array, Strings, Linked List, Trees, Stack / Queue, Heap / Priority Q, Graph, Dynamic Programming, Backtracking, Greedy, Advanced Data Structures, Math / Bit Manipulation, and Sorting Algorithms.
